> **Requires Gladys 5.3 or later.**

Give Gladys a natural voice with [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io): the
announcements of your scenes ("The washing machine has finished", "Someone is
at the door"…) are spoken on your Sonos, Google Cast or AirPlay speakers with
the ElevenLabs voice of your choice.

The integration is a **text-to-speech provider**: once selected as the voice
of Gladys, it replaces Gladys Plus to speak, without a Gladys Plus
subscription.

## Prerequisites

- An [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io) account. The free plan is enough to
  try it; every announcement uses ElevenLabs credits, about one credit per
  character (half with the Flash and v4 Turbo models). See the
  [plans](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing).
- A speaker connected to Gladys: Sonos, Google Cast or AirPlay.
- Gladys installed in **host** network mode (the standard install): the
  speakers download the announcement straight from Gladys, on your local
  network.

## Configuration

1. In ElevenLabs, open [API keys](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys)
   and create a key. A restricted key needs at least the **Text to Speech**
   permission, and **Voices: read** to find a voice by its name. The
   **User: read** permission also shows the credits left.
2. In Gladys, open the configuration screen of the ElevenLabs integration and
   fill in:

| Field                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **API key**            | The key created above (`sk_…`).                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Voice (name or id)** | A voice of your account: its name (`George` by default) or its 20-character id. The voices of the [library](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library) added to your account count. |
| **Model**              | **Flash v2.5** (default): fast, half the credits. **Multilingual v2**: most natural. **v3**: most expressive. **v4**: highest quality. **v4 Turbo**: fast, half the credits.      |
| **Speed**              | From 0.7 (slower) to 1.2 (faster). 1 by default.                                                                                                                                  |
| **Stability**          | From 0 (more expressive and varied) to 1 (steadier). 0.5 by default.                                                                                                              |

3. Save. The connection status then shows for instance `Connected to
ElevenLabs, voice "George". 8,500 of 10,000 credits left, renewed on 12
November.`
4. Open the **Artificial Intelligence** page of Gladys and, in the **Voice
   (text-to-speech provider)** card, select **ElevenLabs**.

### Choosing a voice

The **List my voices** button, below the form, shows the name and the id of
every voice of your account; the voice in use is marked with ✓. Copy a name or
an id into the **Voice** field, then save. Save the API key before using the
button.

For a new voice, browse the
[Voice Library](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library), add it to your
account, then use its name or its id.

## Usage

In a scene, use the **Talk on a speaker** action: pick the speaker and the
text to say. The text can hold scene variables.

- The voice speaks the language of the text. With every model but Multilingual v2, the
  language of the Gladys administrator is also sent, for a better
  pronunciation.
- A sentence already spoken with the same voice and settings is reused without
  using credits, until the integration restarts. One announcement on several
  speakers is synthesized once.
- Gladys says at most 2,000 characters per announcement.

**Voice assistant limit**: with ElevenLabs, the replies of the voice assistant
in the browser or the app stay written. The audio is served by Gladys on your
local network, over `http://`, and the browser refuses to play it in a secure
(`https://`) page. The announcements on the speakers are not affected.

## Troubleshooting

The connection status of the configuration screen shows the problem. An
announcement that could not be spoken is written to the integration logs
(`Speech not synthesized: …`), with the reason.

**"Enter your ElevenLabs API key in the integration settings."** Fill in
**API key** (see "Configuration").

**"ElevenLabs refused the API key: check it in your ElevenLabs settings, then
save it again here."** The key is wrong or was deleted. Nothing is asked to
ElevenLabs until you save a valid key.

**"This voice is not in your ElevenLabs account: use the "List my voices"
button…"** The name or id of the **Voice** field matches no voice of your
account, or the voice was removed from it. Add the voice to your account from
the library, or pick another one, then save.

**"The API key cannot read your voices…"** The restricted key lacks the
**Voices: read** permission: grant it, or enter the voice id instead of its
name.

**"The API key is not allowed to do this (…)"** The key lacks the **Text to
Speech** permission, or your plan does not include the chosen model (the code
in parentheses says which, for instance `model_access_denied`). Change the
permissions of the key or the model.

**"Your ElevenLabs credits are used up…"** Wait for the monthly renewal or
upgrade your plan. The status goes back to "connected" with the first
announcement that works.

**"ElevenLabs cannot be reached: check the Internet connection of Gladys."**,
**"ElevenLabs is not working right now…"** Internet outage or ElevenLabs
incident (see its [status](https://status.elevenlabs.io)).

**The status is "connected" but the speaker says nothing.** Check that
**ElevenLabs** is selected in the **Voice** card of the **Artificial
Intelligence** page, that the integration is running, and that Gladys runs in
host network mode: the speaker must reach Gladys on your local network. The
Gladys server logs warn about a Docker bridge network.

## Privacy

- The API key is stored by Gladys as a secret: it is never shown again in the
  interface.
- The text of the announcements is sent to ElevenLabs to be spoken. See the
  [ElevenLabs privacy policy](https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy). The
  announcements already spoken are kept in memory by the integration, never on
  disk.
- The integration only talks to Gladys and the ElevenLabs API
  (`api.elevenlabs.io`).

## Parámetros de configuración

Estos son los parámetros que ElevenLabs te pide en su pantalla de configuración en Gladys.

| Parámetro | Tipo | Obligatorio | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Your ElevenLabs account | `section` | No | Create an API key in your ElevenLabs settings and paste it below. A restricted key needs the "Text to Speech" permission, and "Voices: read" to find a voice by its name. Every announcement uses ElevenLabs credits; a sentence already spoken with the same voice is reused for free. Then select ElevenLabs as the voice of Gladys on the Artificial Intelligence page. |
| API key | `secret` | Sí |  |
| Voice (name or id) | `string` | Sí | A voice of your account: its name (George, Sarah…) or its id. The "List my voices" button below shows them all. |
| Model | `select` | No |  |
| Speed (0.7 to 1.2) | `number` | No |  |
| Stability (0 to 1) | `number` | No | Lower: more expressive and varied. Higher: steadier, more monotonous. |

## Cómo instalar ElevenLabs en Gladys

1. En Gladys, abre **Integraciones**: ElevenLabs aparece en el catálogo junto a las integraciones nativas, con una insignia de comunidad.
2. Haz clic en **Instalar**. Gladys descarga la imagen Docker (`ghcr.io/cicoub13/gladys-elevenlabs:1.1.0`), la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo y genera la interfaz de la integración (dispositivos, descubrimiento y configuración).
3. Abre la pantalla de **Configuración** de la integración, rellena los parámetros y guarda.
4. También puedes instalarla directamente desde la URL de su repositorio: [https://github.com/cicoub13/gladys-elevenlabs](https://github.com/cicoub13/gladys-elevenlabs).

ElevenLabs requiere Gladys `>=5.3.0`. El catálogo de Gladys se actualiza cada hora, así que una nueva versión está disponible como máximo una hora después de publicarse.

¿Todavía no usas Gladys? Es gratuito y de código abierto: [sigue la guía de instalación](/es/docs/) para empezar.

## Sobre las integraciones externas

ElevenLabs es una **integración externa**: una integración comunitaria empaquetada como contenedor Docker y publicada en GitHub. Gladys la instala con un clic y la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo. La publica y mantiene [cicoub13](https://github.com/cicoub13), no el equipo principal de Gladys.
